0022600100.text: New Orleans visits Utah with neither team having played a 2026-27 game yet. The Jazz are missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out. The Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently a 156-137 road win... wait, that game was in New Orleans.
